Chapter 6439: I Won’T Kill You Today

Chapter 6439: I Won’t Kill You Today

“Damn!” Other primal ancestors became alarmed after seeing the attack.

Seventy-two Origin Ancestor took advantage of this opportunity and showed no mercy. The duo was shaken since they couldn’t stop this attack.

“Enough, Seventy-two.” A planetary-level explosion detonated as a hand came out of nowhere and crushed the lightning spear.

A unique divinity appeared in the air. Neither oppressive nor holy, this one came from the human world.

A figure appeared and it spread throughout the realms. His presence initiated wondrous visual phenomena such as golden springs and spirit deers. Trees and rocks became sentient and full of spirituality.

Cultivators in Old World were in awe. Even emperors and desolate gods wanted to be purified by it.

People immediately saw a mountain range and he was the divine peak. It wasn’t overly tall and imposing but served as a tablet or a guiding lamp.

“North Kun God.” The origin ancestor’s expression changed.

Everyone was shocked to hear his title. Primal ancestors couldn’t stay calm.

The overlord of gold in the dream world prostrated upon learning of his arrival. It was no exaggeration to call him a supreme master in both Desolate Frontier and all of Old World.

He was a direct disciple of Desolate Ancestor, bestowed the desolate god path. He was in training after Everlasting Jiang’s death but it seemed the dream phenomenon was enough to summon him.

“I won’t kill you today, leave.” He spoke, being on a level higher than any other combatant.

Listeners became frozen because primal ancestors stood no chance against him. This included the origin ancestor who was once in the extinguish stage. Everyone thought he would become a supreme overlord.

Many primal ancestors lost their pride in his presence. Now, North Kun God disrespected him.

“Is he that strong?” A big shot whispered.

His comment implied how easy it was for him to kill Seventy-two Origin Ancestor. Everyone knew he was on the return path, but how far had he gone?

He witnessed Everlasting Jiang and Fardao’s attempt. Fairy Companions were there as well.

“Did he find the door to the overlord level?” One emperor shuddered.

“Then it would be easy for him to kill the origin ancestor. Everlasting Jiang’s death would not be in vain.” A primal ancestor took a deep breath.

“Rather confident.” Seventy-two Origin Ancestor’s wings pulsed brightly.

“Crackle!” An ocean of heavenly power gathered above, reminding everyone of tribulations.

In terms of age, Seventy-two Origin Ancestor was older than North Kun God. His talent should be better as well.

He was in the extinguish stage earlier - the equivalent to the return path. Unfortunately, Supreme Black Ancestor weakened his cultivation.

“Killing you is not a problem.” North Kun God said.

This statement made everyone think he was at the door of the next realm already, causing them to watch with bated breath.

His bloodlust against the origin ancestor was justified. Despite being Desolate Ancestor’s disciple, she left after becoming immortal and didn’t spend much time teaching him. Thus, his senior brother, Xianting, taught him instead. This naturally strengthened their bond.

He wasn’t strong enough to avenge his senior brother in the past, not to mention the origin ancestor being protected due to sentiments for his parents.

The origin ancestor clenched his fists, believing in the opponent’s potential. He was filled with rage because this should have been him. Alas, his cultivation was stuck in the eternal stage.

The source of his ongoing suffering was none other than Desolate Ancestor.
